title: 提示
summary: 报一条消息只说了要出声。先定打断到哪一档：瞄一眼、自动消失、还能撤销、留档、还是必须处理。
summaryEn: Naming a notice only says it should speak. First pick the interruption weight: a glance, auto-dismiss, an undo, a log, or must-handle.
asks: 这条提示该打断到哪一档？
asksEn: How loudly should this notice interrupt?

links.when: 若必须先处理才能继续
links.whenEn: if they must handle it before they can continue

links.when: 提示不打断当前任务，弹窗才打断
links.whenEn: a notice does not interrupt the task; a dialog does
a result notice is not progress

links.when: 结果 toast 不是提交后的成功页
links.whenEn: a result toast is not the success after submit
